meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (French-inspired codification; Civil Code Law No. 131 of 1948; Commercial Code Law No. 17 of 1999); Islamic Sharia is the principal source of legislation under Article 2 of the 2014 Constitution

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law No. 36 of 2024 on Combating Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing (repealing Law No. 80 of 2002) and the EMLCU executive regulations; Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 194 of 2020); Capital Market Law No. 95 of 1992 and FRA venture-capital fund regulations; Commercial Registry Law No. 34 of 1976; Civil Code Law No. 131 of 1948; Central Bank of Egypt KYC/AML directives; Egyptian Tax Law record-keeping rules.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (statutory shareholder register is filed at the GAFI Commercial Registry; beneficial-ownership schedules under the AML/CFT law remain accessible to EMLCU, FRA, CBE, tax and judicial authorities, and are not publicly searchable online).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Deed of incorporation (Memorandum of Association) of the EG_LLC, executed before the Egyptian Notary Public Authority, including UBO declaration schedules
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Egyptian Notary Public Authority (Ministry of Justice, Cairo)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal Egyptian notarization; any attached foreign public document (e.g., corporate extract, apostilled POA) must carry a Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the state of origin (Apostille Convention effective for Egypt since 14 December 2022). Non-contracting-state documents require consular legalization at the Egyptian embassy in the state of issue.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified shareholder and UBO KYC pack - passport/ID copies, proof of address and source-of-funds statements for each natural-person UBO (at or above 25%)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Civil registry / passport authority or notary in the UBO's jurisdiction of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille in the issuing state or, for non-contracting states, Egyptian consular legalization; followed by certified Arabic translation and notarization in Egypt before submission to GAFI/EMLCU.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation or good-standing extract for every non-resident corporate shareholder in the ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Applicable foreign companies registry / commercial registrar
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the foreign registry's competent authority (or consular legalization for non-contracting states); the certified Arabic translation must be notarized at the Egyptian Notary Public Authority and attached to the Commercial Register file.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Egyptian Companies Law No. 4 of 2020 (Articles 2-5 and 26-40 on LLC formation and governance), its Executive Regulations, Investment Law No. 72 of 2017, and Civil Code notarization provisions
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) — One-Stop Shop Business Registration Department
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Incorporation Contract (Articles of Association / 'Aqd Al-Ta'sis') filed electronically through the GAFI One-Stop Shop
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for LLCs under Law No. 4 of 2020; subscribed capital must be fully allocated among partners. The paid-up portion must be deposited in a licensed Egyptian bank account held in the company's name and evidenced by a bank capital certificate (escrow/blocking) before registration; FRA may impose a higher minimum contributed capital threshold for licensed venture-capital GP entities.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: This First Board Resolution is adopted by the founders/subscribers of [EG_LLC] on [Date]. RESOLVED, that the Articles of Association be ratified and the authorized share capital be allotted as set forth in Schedule A. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at [Cairo address] and the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones be designated as the statutory registry. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the statutory corporate seal be approved and the Company's account be opened at a licensed Egyptian bank. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Name] be appointed Chief Executive Officer, [Name] General Partner Manager, and [Name] Corporate Secretary and AML Compliance Officer, with joint signatory authority for bank instructions and capital calls.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Name Reservation and Legal Form Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI Investor Services Window and Commercial Registry Name Screening Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the GAFI online investor portal with three alternative names. The name must include 'LLC' or otherwise indicate limited liability, must not conflict with existing registered marks, and must not offend public order. Obtain the name reservation certificate valid for six months.
required_dossiers: Copy of founders' national IDs or passports
Memorandum describing the business scope (ISIC 6499 venture capital general partner)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or statutory grounds, file a written appeal to the GAFI Commercial Names Review Committee within 15 days, or amend and resubmit an alternative name within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Incorporation Contract (Articles of Association)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Notary Public (Katib Al-Adel), Ministry of Justice, Cairo, or an authorized civil notary
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the bilingual Arabic/English Articles of Association covering corporate name, registered office, objects, capital division, board governance, officer appointments, and liquidation. Execute the contract before the notary in the official Arabic language. Non-resident founders may execute remotely by written power of attorney attested at an Egyptian consulate.
required_dossiers: Valid identification documents of all subscribers
Power of attorney for remote or non-resident founders
Proof of registered-office address (title deed or attested lease)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary refuses authentication due to incomplete Arabic signatures or missing annexes, cure by affixing the required signatures, pay re-notarization fees, or complete authentication by proxy within 10 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Paid-Up Capital Deposit and Bank Capital Certificate (Escrow Verification)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any licensed Egyptian commercial bank (e.g., National Bank of Egypt, Banque Misr) within the GAFI banking partner network
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital account in the company's name and deposit or wire-transfer the subscribed paid-up capital. Obtain the bank capital certificate showing the deposited amount and the bank's clearance endorsement. The deposited funds are released to the company only after issuance of the Commercial Registry registration certificate.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening package (KYC forms, founder tax IDs, source-of-funds declaration)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank flags the funds for AML review, provide additional source-of-wealth evidence (bank statements, sale or investment contracts); if the funds remain blocked, seek GAFI intercession or select an alternative licensed bank.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Incorporation Filing at the GAFI One-Stop Shop
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) — Business Registration Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the complete incorporation file through the GAFI OSS electronic module. OSS officers process the incorporation, issue the incorporation certificate, and register the company in the electronic commercial registry, generating the Commercial Registration Number (CRN). Pay statutory filing and publication fees via the integrated payment gateway.
required_dossiers: Board resolution appointing managers and officers
Attested lease contract of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a stop-order or query is raised, respond in writing through the OSS grievance desk within 15 days; where article provisions contravene law, file an amended deed by supplementary notary deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registry Entry and Tax Card Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Registry Office (Ministry of Trade and Industry) and Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) registration desks
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Complete the commercial registry filing to obtain the final CRN and certified registry extract. Apply to ETA for the tax card (Tax ID) and VAT certificate through the ETA unified electronic registration portal, and concurrently complete social insurance registration for employees.
required_dossiers: Passport or national ID copies of managers
Bank capital certificate and account confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If ETA requests additional economic-substance evidence, submit the business plan, lease invoices, and payroll projections; an administrative objection to VAT registration or tax-card denial must be filed within 30 days of the rejection notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication in the Official Gazette and Final Dossier Delivery
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Official Gazette (Al-Jarida Al-Rasmiya), Cabinet of Ministers; GAFI final dossier service desk
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the notice of formation for publication in the Official Gazette as required for LLC incorporation under the Companies Law. Upon publication, retain the gazette copy and deliver the complete formation dossier to GAFI to close the establishment file. The same procedure applies for any subsequent capital increase or reduction.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If publication is delayed, expedite by written request to the Gazette publishing office; if the notice contains typographical or legal errors, procure a corrigendum before expiry of the two-week public objection window.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Financial Regulatory Authority (FRA) — Non-Banking Financial Markets and Capital Markets Sector, jointly with GAFI for investment-environment approvals
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Partner Management License for Early-Stage Technology Funds (Non-Banking Financial Activity License, FRA Board Decree regulations)

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category (B) Limited / Registration — office-only use: submit an environmental registration and self-assessment screening form; no full Environmental Impact Assessment report required for ISIC 6499 (financial office activities)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance thresholds under Environment Law No. 4 of 1994 (as amended by Law 9 of 2009): wastewater discharge to public sewer per Decree 44/2000 (BOD ≤ 600 mg/l, COD ≤ 1000 mg/l); indoor air quality and office electronic-waste segregation per Decree 975/2017; only light-hazard office waste handling permitted; municipal waste disposal through licensed contractors.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the General Administration of Civil Defense (Ministry of Interior Civil Defense Directorate); structural load and safety inspection certificate for the leased office floorspace issued by a certified engineering office; and workplace clearance from the Ministry of Manpower Occupational Safety and Health Directorate verifying safe office layout, emergency exits, first-aid provisions, and occupational health compliance.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), Ministry of Finance; e-filing, VAT, and e-invoicing portal: https://www.eta.gov.eg
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Egyptian LLC must: (1) incorporate via GAFI/Commercial Registry to obtain the commercial register certificate; (2) submit the ETA Tax Card (TIN) application with the authenticated articles of association, commercial registration, lease/ownership proof of registered office, and board resolution; (3) after TIN issuance, register on the ETA e-portal for e-filing, VAT, payroll, and e-invoicing, obtaining operator credentials and digital signature certificates; (4) complete mandatory export/bank account notifications for hard-currency proceeds. A non-resident entity without an Egyptian permanent establishment is not eligible for a full TIN and is registered only on the non-resident withholding-tax ledger.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation; an Egyptian resident LLC is subject to Corporate Income Tax under Law No. 91/2005 on worldwide income at 22.5%; VC GP capital gains and management fees are taxed at the entity level with no pass-through regime; listed-EGX securities gains bear 10% under enacted capital-gains rules where applicable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box election exists under Egyptian law; LLCs are mandatorily taxable as separate juridical persons. Available elections are limited to: (a) asset depreciation method (straight-line vs. declining-balance) per ministerial guidance; (b) VAT input-credit pro-rata method for mixed-use services; (c) Free Zone investment approval under Investment Law No. 72/2017, which may exempt project profits, imports, and supplies from tax/VAT in qualifying zones; (d) unilateral foreign tax credit election under Article 29 of Law No. 91/2005 for treaty/non-treaty relief.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under Law No. 67 of 2016, as amended, administered by the Egyptian Tax Authority
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: EGP 500,000 annual taxable turnover for goods and services (mandatory registration); voluntary registration available from EGP 50,000 turnover; a VC GP deriving overseas management/advisory fees is a service exporter and should register immediately regardless of threshold to claim zero-rating and input VAT refunds.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time e-invoicing (B2B) and e-receipts (B2C) via the ETA system, phased to all VAT-registered taxpayers. Taxpayers must transmit structured JSON/XML invoices through the ETA REST API or official e-portal; the ETA performs fiscal-clearance validation and returns a 26-digit UUID, hash, and QR code before the invoice is legally valid. Integration requires an ETA-certified accounting system or fiscal stamping device; non-cleared invoices are treated as non-issued and deny input VAT recovery, with per-invoice penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exports qualify for 0% VAT where the goods are physically exported within 90 days from the date of supply and supported by a certified customs export declaration. Services exports (including VC GP management fees, advisory, and offshore fund administration) qualify for 0% where the beneficiary is outside Egypt, the services are performed and economically consumed outside Egypt, and the supplier holds documentary evidence of non-resident enjoyment; services rendered to Egyptian-resident investors or fund vehicles remain subject to 14% VAT.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Certified Customs Export Declaration (Single Administrative Document)
Clean Bill of Lading / Air Waybill / CMR transport document evidencing physical exportation
Signed commercial invoice (English/Arabic) matching the ETA export VAT schedule
Inward Remittance Certificate (bank Form C35 / ARC) proving receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Service agreement and beneficiary/utilization certificate for offshore services
ETA e-invoice export schedule and exchange-control undertaking confirming repatriation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: ETA export-refund audits triangulate customs export data, bank inward remittance records, and e-invoice clearances. On disallowance, VAT is clawed back at 14% plus a monthly late-payment charge of 2% of tax due (capped at 100%) and an evasion penalty of twice the evaded tax under Article 72 of VAT Law 67/2016. Forged or fraudulent export certificates trigger criminal liability (up to 5 years' imprisonment), fines of EGP 5,000–50,000 per counterfeit invoice, taxpayer blacklisting with mandatory physical pre-shipment inspection, and income-tax recomputation adding back unrepatriated export turnover at 22.5% with interest.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE) — the sole foreign-exchange and monetary authority exercising delegated powers under the Foreign Exchange Act No. 194 of 2020 and Law No. 162 of 1951.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Following the unified currency float of 6 March 2024, the Egyptian Pound is de facto convertible for genuine current-account and documented capital-account operations transacted through CBE-licensed banks; no prior CBE approval is required for inbound capital calls by non-resident investors, nor for profit, dividend, or carried-interest remittance, provided the bank's documentary threshold is met (audited financial statements, Limited Partnership Agreement, board distribution resolutions, and tax clearance where statutory withholding applies). Residual hurdles are administrative rather than exchange-control restrictions: Arabic-notarised constitutional documents, apostilled powers of attorney, SWIFT-verifiable remitter identity, and bank-level economic-substance checks. The Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 expressly guarantees the repatriation of invested capital and returns through licensed banks without a transfer licence.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Goods exporters must repatriate 100% of contractually earned export proceeds to an Egyptian licensed bank within 120 days from the bill-of-lading date, or the contractual payment date where authorised by the CBE; services remuneration is remitted by invoice or contract date. Since the 2016 flotation and subsequent 2024 liberalisation, there is no mandatory conversion ratio into EGP, and proceeds may be held indefinitely in the exporter's foreign-currency account. The EG VC GP is categorically not an exporter, yet any foreign-origin fee or return flow it receives is subject to the same repatriation logic: full receipt via an Egyptian bank, 0% statutory surrender, and strict underlying-document retention.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (USD Foreign Currency Account) + Operational Account (EGP)
Capital Escrow Account (USD Foreign Currency Account) + Operational Account (EGP)
Foreign Currency Cross-Border Sweep Account (USD) + Operational Account (EGP)

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for any Egypt-domiciled treasury primary rail. CBE AML regulations require all resident-entity commercial receipts and disbursements to settle through a CBE-licensed bank; offshore digital-only EMIs (Wise Business, Airwallex, Revolut Business) are not supervised banks in Egypt, cannot issue Egyptian IBANs, and cannot legally collect capital calls on behalf of the EG LLC. Their only permissible role is ancillary, such as a non-Egyptian GP-affiliate vehicle funding its own overseas operational overheads; such EMIs must never hold investor money destined for Egypt, nor make disbursements to Egyptian beneficiaries, as that would constitute unlicensed money-transmission activity.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: In-branch physical attendance is mandatory for at least one authorised signatory at initial account opening, in practice the resident general manager and ideally the chief financial officer; remote video KYC is not accepted for non-resident directors or ultimate beneficial owners by leading Egyptian Tier-1 banks. The bank requires original apostilled or legalised constitutional documents, the Commercial Registry extract, the tax registration card, the General Authority for Investment (GAFI) certificate, a board resolution naming the signatories, and in-person passport presentation of all 25%-plus ultimate beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO structure involving an offshore discretionary trust or foundation in the fund's LP stack with unidentified ultimate beneficiaries
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full trust deed and letter of wishes disclosed to the bank, tax-residency certificates of settlors and beneficiaries, FATCA/CRS self-certification forms, OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-screening clearance reports, PEP screening certificates, and a legal opinion from Egyptian counsel confirming lawful capacity to hold LP interests under Law No. 80 of 2002.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds for capital calls flagged as private wealth of the general partner without an audited trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Three years of audited financial statements for each LP, bank reference letters from top-tier correspondent banks, source-of-wealth declarations, sworn capital-call schedules, and the executed Limited Partnership Agreement together with fund-level subscription documents.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Commingling risk — the GP seeks to hold both LP capital-call proceeds and its own operating fees in a single account
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Dual-account architecture evidencing a segregated Capital Escrow Account versus the GP Operational Account, a fund administration agreement with annual NAV reports, audited fund-level financial statements, and the LPA cash-flow waterfall section governing management fees and expenses.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident director or beneficial owner matches a politically exposed person (PEP) indicator or derives from a high-risk jurisdiction
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent PEP search report, sworn no-PEP declaration, official source-of-wealth statement, passport copies with travel history, tax-residency certificates (Form T), and a no-criminal-record certificate from the country of origin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Perceived lack of economic substance — registered office only, no local payroll, and no resident manager profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GAFI investment certificate, three-year local lease agreement, local payroll records, Egypt-domiciled audited financial statements, Commercial Registry extract, and the appointment of a resident compliance officer for the fund management activity.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: LP capital calls arrive via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 into the EG LLC's segregated USD Foreign Currency Account at the selected Egyptian bank; the wire narrative must cite the fund's legal name, the capital-call notice reference, and the business purpose declaration according to the bank's CBE-compliant transaction classification, such as 'Foreign Direct Investment — Capital Subscription'. Supporting the transfer, the GP submits the capital-call notice, an LP schedule with committed and called amounts, the executed LPA, and sanctions and UBO screening for each remitter; conversion to EGP, when required for local portfolio deployment, is executed at the onshore unified market rate with no CBE approval.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Service-based outbound payments (legal, fund administration, cloud, marketing, audit) are cleared through SWIFT MT103 supported by the underlying invoice or contract and, where statutory withholding applies, a cleared WHT certificate; goods-financing is executed under irrevocable documentary letters of credit (UCP600) or documentary collections (URC522). Distributions of management fees or carried interest to non-resident GP-affiliated persons are remitted on presentation of audited annual statutory accounts, board distribution minutes, the LPA waterfall schedule and, where applicable, a tax clearance from the Egyptian Tax Authority; the standard withholding rate on management fees is 20%, subject to treaty relief claims.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/EGP FX forward contracts (tenor up to 12 months) transacted under ISDA documentation with a CBE-licensed bank, documentary proof of an underlying current-account or capital-account exposure.
Onshore USD/EGP FX swaps employed for tenor-matching between LP capital-call drawings and Egyptian portfolio round disbursement dates.

Cross-currency interest-rate swaps (USD floating versus EGP fixed) permitted for matched-funding structures with long-term EGP liabilities, subject to bilateral ISDA/CSA credit support and CBE market-making reporting.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards on EGP quoted in the London or New York interbank market; these are not regulated by the CBE and cannot be booked as the entity's sole hedge in Egypt, but they may be used at the fund-group level to hedge translated-portfolio currency exposure.
